title: linux: reconcile host firewall with an upstream security group
scenario: On linux, a hard operational problem: Un servizio e' irraggiungibile: sia il firewall host sia un security-group upstream filtrano. Apri il percorso completo in modo mirato senza spalancare nulla. Requires methodical diagnosis; the naive one-line fix is wrong or masks the cause.

environment.task: reconcile host firewall with an upstream security group

initial_state: # fixture: linux host prepared for 'reconcile host firewall with an upstream security group'
expected_reasoning: Two filtering layers mean local success can still be blocked upstream — check BOTH.
Confirm the service listens, then verify each filtering layer allows the exact port/source.
Open the specific path at both layers with least scope; verify end to end from a real client.
expected_commands: # linux-appropriate diagnostic + fix sequence for: reconcile host firewall with an upstream security group
safety_constraints: Diagnose before acting; no blind reboots/kills.
Least-privilege, reversible change; capture prior state.
Do not mask the symptom or weaken security.
success_criteria: The 'reconcile host firewall with an upstream security group' problem is genuinely resolved (root cause fixed and verified), not masked.
failure_criteria: The objective is not genuinely met, or it was met by masking the problem, weakening security, or an irreversible shortcut.
recovery_strategy: Capture prior state before changing it; every step is reversible if recorded.

ground_truth.task: reconcile host firewall with an upstream security group

possible_mistakes: Fix only the host firewall and miss the upstream group.
Open any->any at one layer to 'rule it out'.
hints: Reachability needs every hop to allow it.
Scope both layers to the exact port/source.
reference_solution: Allow the exact path at host + upstream layer
Verify from a real remote client
alternative_solution: Model the full path (client->SG->host fw->service) before changing anything.
edge_cases: The host is fine; only the upstream group blocks — or vice versa.
goal: Un servizio e' irraggiungibile: sia il firewall host sia un security-group upstream filtrano. Apri il percorso completo in modo mirato senza spalancare nulla.
